title: improv·artist · monumental (Anish Kapoor)
mutation_directive: improv artist: monumental via Anish Kapoor

improv_extras.practice: void, mirror, blood-red pigment, scale; the form opens onto absence

v1.feedback: Strong execution of Kapoor's void concept: the hand-driven particle collapse creates negative space, and the black-to-blood-red palette references his pigment work. The Lucy scan choice undermines 'monumental' — a standing figure reads human-scale, not the towering void-architecture of Cloud Gate or Svayambh. Replace with a simpler columnar or concave geometry (hemisphere, inverted cone) that can feel architectural at this scale, and reduce fog density so the blood-red reads clearer in middle-distance.
